about_the_game:
Stranded on the Moon. Out of fuel. Out of luck. And somehow... still laughing.

In Together: Moon Escape, you and a partner must cooperate to escape a chaotic lunar mission gone very, very wrong. Explore a variety of handcrafted levels — from crumbling space stations to dusty caves and eerie lunar bases — all packed with puzzles, surprises, and way too many Slimes.

This is not your average serious space game. Expect absurd tools, ridiculous logic, and nonstop co-op chaos. Whether you're arguing over a puzzle or laughing at your partner falling into a crater (again), you’ll need each other to get home.

🧠 Features

  • 2-player online or local co-op – Grab a friend and play split-screen or over the internet. No solo mode: this Moon demands teamwork.

  • Chaotic co-op puzzles – Communication is key! You’ll each see different things, control different systems, or need to act in perfect sync.

  • Lunar exploration – Escape across varied environments like the Moon’s surface, dark caves, derelict ships, and secret facilities.

  • Ridiculous tools – Use special weapons and gadgets like the Slime Blaster or the Slime Vision Goggles to solve puzzles and prank your partner.

  • Optimized for smooth performance – Built with Unreal Engine and fully optimized for low-end systems and Steam Deck (runs at 60fps).

  • Short, sweet, and full of laughter – Designed to be completed in a few sessions, but with plenty of replay value and jokes to keep you coming back.
